description: List the Cruma agents running for this user (the desktop app, headless agents, and this session's own agent) and the profiles that are not running. Each running agent shows its `version` and release `channel` (stable and preview agents can run side by side), when it started (`started_at`, `age_secs`) and who started it (`starter`: user_start, installed_service, desktop_app or coding_session with the client and process id when known, unknown for an agent that does not record it), plus its tunnel domain, whether the tunnel is anonymous or signed-in account state, its server-reported tunnel plan when known, its sites (hostnames) and hosted processes, whether changes made here are saved, and whether it also serves HTTP /mcp. The build, start and starter facts show even when an agent does not answer in time; the live facts then are absent. `attached` marks the agent every other tool here talks to. A profile that is not running comes with a `start_hint`; this tool never starts one.
name: list_agents
